description: This file contains functions for managing and applying runtime controls for an ACP (possibly Automated Control Plane) system, including capability resolution and control application with error handling.

methods.name: resolveManagerRuntimeCapabilities
methods.description: Resolves and returns the capabilities of a given runtime, including supported controls and configuration keys.

methods.name: applyManagerRuntimeControls
methods.description: Applies runtime controls such as mode and configuration options, with error handling and caching.
